_comment: Upper bounds for the CI benchmark's medians (Tests/PetrichoriOSUITests/PerformanceUITests.swift), read by .github/scripts/perf-gate.py. Calibrated on GitHub-hosted macos-26 (Debug build, iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator), 2026-11-07: about 2x the observed median, so a gross regression fails and runner noise does not. NavigationTransition includes the fixed ~1 s zoom animation, so its headroom is in absolute terms (+0.6 s of main-thread stall). Recalibrate from several runs' tables, never from one outlier.
